about.title: About ANPG
about.subtitle: Institutional
about.description: Learn about Angola's National Oil, Gas and Biofuels Agency and our mission to regulate the energy sector.

content.mission: To manage the National Petroleum System by promoting and regulating the execution of petroleum activities, striving for value creation for stakeholders, application of best practices and transparent operations.
content.vision: To be recognized as a National Regulatory Agency of Excellence.
content.intro: The National Oil, Gas and Biofuels Agency, abbreviated ANPG, was created by Presidential Decree No. 49/19 of February 6th. ANPG is a Public Law Legal Entity endowed with legal personality, administrative, financial and patrimonial autonomy.
content.role: ANPG is the National Concessionaire and Regulatory Body for petroleum activities. In this capacity, ANPG is responsible for negotiating petroleum concession contracts, promoting access and new investment opportunities, as well as administering and supervising concession areas for exploration and production of oil, natural gas and their derivatives throughout the national territory.
content.pcaMessage: The National Oil, Gas and Biofuels Agency, abbreviated ANPG, created by Presidential Decree No. 49/19 of February 6th, is the National Concessionaire responsible for managing and optimizing E&P operations, with the objective of ensuring sector sustainability and more effective governance and oversight.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Legal
privacy.description: Information on how ANPG collects, uses, and protects your personal data.
privacy.intro: The National Oil, Gas and Biofuels Agency (ANPG) is committed to protecting the privacy and personal data of all users of our website. This policy describes our practices for collecting, using, and protecting information.

collection.title: Data Collection
collection.content: We collect information you provide directly, such as name, email address, company, and position when you fill out forms on our website, particularly for meeting scheduling, expression of interest in petroleum blocks, or information requests. We also automatically collect browsing data, including IP address, browser type, and pages visited.

usage.title: Data Usage
usage.content: We use your data to respond to your requests, process information inquiries, send communications related to investment opportunities and tenders, and improve our services. Data is processed based on your consent or ANPG's legitimate interest in fulfilling its institutional functions.

security.title: Security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or destruction. Our systems are regularly audited and updated to ensure information security.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, rectify, delete, or limit the processing of your personal data. You may also request data portability or object to its processing. To exercise these rights, contact us via the email provided below.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: Our website uses essential cookies for site functionality and analytics cookies to understand how visitors interact with our pages. You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: For questions related to data protection or to exercise your rights, contact our Data Protection Officer at privacidade@anpg.co.ao.

hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.description: Find answers to the most common questions about investing in Angola's petroleum sector and tendering processes.

faq.intro: We have compiled the most frequently asked questions from investors and partners about investment opportunities, tendering processes and operational requirements in Angola.

contactCta.text: Didn't find the answer you were looking for?

q1.question: What are the main investment opportunities in Angola?
q1.answer: Angola offers opportunities in onshore and offshore exploration, mature field development, natural gas projects and supporting infrastructure. The 2025 Tender and Permanent Offer provide blocks in the Kwanza and Benguela basins with proven potential.

q2.question: What is the minimum investment required?
q2.answer: The minimum investment varies depending on the block type and proposed work programme. Specific terms are defined in each tender's bidding documents. Generally, financial guarantees and minimum investment commitments are required during the exploration period.

q3.question: How can I express interest before a tender?
q3.answer: You can register on the Investor Portal to receive updates on new opportunities. For formal expressions of interest, use the form available on the respective tender page or contact ANPG directly.

q4.question: Are there tax incentives for investors?
q4.answer: Angola offers a competitive tax regime for the petroleum sector, including incentives for deep and ultra-deep water exploration. Specific tax terms are negotiated on a case-by-case basis and detailed in production sharing contracts.

q1.question: How do ANPG tenders work?
q1.answer: Tenders follow a transparent process that includes: publication of the notice, data consultation period, proposal submission, technical and commercial evaluation, and award. The entire process is regulated by Angolan legislation and supervised by competent authorities.

q2.question: Who can participate in tenders?
q2.answer: National and foreign companies that meet technical and financial qualification requirements can participate. Proven experience in hydrocarbon exploration and production is required, as well as adequate financial capacity for the proposed work programme.

q3.question: What is the typical deadline for proposal submission?
q3.answer: After the official launch, bidders typically have 30 to 40 days to submit proposals. We recommend that interested companies register in advance to access technical data and prepare their proposals adequately.

q4.question: How are proposals evaluated?
q4.answer: Evaluation considers technical criteria (work programme, operational capacity, experience) and commercial criteria (signature bonus, investment commitments, state participation). The relative weights are defined in each tender notice.

q1.question: What type of contracts are used?
q1.answer: Angola uses the Production Sharing Contract (PSC) model, as established by the Petroleum Activities Law. This model defines the sharing of costs and production between the State and operators, ensuring mutual benefits.

q2.question: What is the typical contract duration?
q2.answer: The initial exploration period is 4 to 5 years, extendable with technical justification. After commercial discovery, the development and production period can extend for 20 to 25 years, depending on the field's characteristics.

q3.question: What are the environmental requirements?
q3.answer: All operations must comply with Angolan environmental legislation and international best practices. Environmental Impact Studies (EIS) are mandatory before the start of activities, as well as decommissioning plans.

q1.question: What is the Local Content policy?
q1.answer: The Local Content policy aims to maximise the participation of Angolan companies and workers in the petroleum sector value chain. It includes local hiring requirements, professional training and technology transfer.

q2.question: Is Angolan company participation mandatory?
q2.answer: Yes, participation of Angolan companies in consortia and the supply chain is encouraged and in many cases mandatory. Specific requirements vary according to the contract type and are detailed in the bidding documents.

q3.question: What support exists for local companies?
q3.answer: ANPG promotes training and local supplier development programmes. There are also incentives for partnerships between international and Angolan companies, facilitating knowledge and technology transfer.

q1.question: How can I access technical data on blocks?
q1.answer: Technical data is available through the IONA platform and Investor Portal. For access to detailed data packages, including seismic information, a formal request to ANPG is required, and access fees may apply.

q2.question: What type of data is available?
q2.answer: We provide geological, geophysical (2D and 3D seismic), well reports, reservoir studies and concession maps. The extent of data varies according to each block's exploration history.

q3.question: Is the data confidential?
q3.answer: Yes, technical data is treated confidentially. Access is controlled and users must sign confidentiality agreements before receiving sensitive information about blocks.
